{{Quote|I am known as Amity. I am a pilgrim of the Messengers of the Cold Moon.|Amity|<ref name="PITF" />|quotestart=0|translated=1}}
'''Amity''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] raised by the [[Selonian/Legends|Selonians]]<ref name="TORweb" /> and later a part of the [[Messengers of the Cold Moon]].<ref name="TCMT" />

==Biography==
{{Quote|I was once a soldier in the Republic Army. I had seen my share of battle&mdash;of Jedi and Sith, Republic and Imperial troopers throwing away their lives.|Amity recounts his past|<ref name="PITF" />|quotestart=0|translated=1}}
As an orphan, Amity was taken in by the [[Selonian Enclave]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. He later enlisted in the [[Republic Army]] to repay their kindness, but during the [[Battle of Corellia]] he had a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] and told his [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]], [[Sull Caxe]], who later instructed him not to tell anyone. The following day, Amity's vision came true when the Republic raided a factory and then [[Desertion/Legends|deserted]] the Republic after the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] destroyed most of the sector.<ref name="VOTP">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Visions of the Past|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref> After leaving the Republic, he received more visions and asked the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] for help. The Jedi had rejected him for being too old, but he eventually met the elders of the [[Messengers of the Cold Moon]], who accepted him to their group.<ref name="PITF" />

==Personality and traits==
After seeing so much death during his time in the Republic Army, Amity was tired of fighting and desired peace. However, he was a skilled warrior, and would fight if necessary.<ref name="TCMT" /> Amity had been severely wounded during his time in the Republic, and had a scorched face and blaster marks on his body. Because it made others uncomfortable to see his wounds, he wore armor to hide them. He also admitted that he preferred to hide his wounds anyway.<ref name="PITF" />

==Equipment==
After joining the Messengers of the Cold Moon, Amity wore armor to hide his wounds.<ref name="PITF" /> He also carried an electrostaff for combat.<ref name="TCMT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Amity was introduced as a companion in the [[2023]] Game Update 7.2.1 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'', the eighth digital expansion to the [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Players can obtain Amity as a companion in the Galactic Season 4 "A Passage of Peace" event.<ref name="TORweb" />
